# SHARE OTSU Organ Donor Registry Portal

> Official organ donor registration platform for the Southern Philippines Medical Center (SPMC) and Department of Health (DOH) in Davao City, Philippines.

## Overview
- Organization: SHARE Organ Transplant Services Unit (OTSU)
- Institution: Southern Philippines Medical Center (SPMC) & Department of Health (DOH)
- Legal Basis: Republic Act No. 7170 (Organ Donation Act of 1991)
- Mission: Modernize organ donation awareness, voluntary registry signup, and family communication across the Philippines.

## Key Facts
- Impact: A single deceased organ donor can save up to 8 lives and restore vision and mobility to over 50 tissue recipients.
- Cost: 100% free and voluntary. All retrieval and transplant surgery costs are covered by the program, never billed to donor families.
- Medical Priority: Emergency room and trauma doctors prioritize saving the patient's life first. Organ donation evaluation occurs strictly following certified clinical brain death.
- Religious Stance: Major world religions (Catholicism, Protestantism, Islam, Buddhism) affirm organ donation as an altruistic act of love and mercy.

## Available Actions
- Register as an organ donor: Select specific organs (Heart, Lungs, Liver, Kidneys, Pancreas, Bones, Eyes, Skin) or all organs and tissues.
- Digital Donor Card: Fills the official SHARE OTSU donor card (front and back) with the donor's name, blood type, next of kin, contact number, and chosen organs, and saves it as a PNG.
- Family Communication: Mandates legal notification to ensure next-of-kin honor the donor's wishes.

## Contact & Location
- Location: Southern Philippines Medical Center, J.P. Laurel Avenue, Bajada, Davao City, Philippines
- Social: https://www.facebook.com/SHAREOTSU
